description: Tells Flash Console what Codex is doing, and brings in the FlashTeams briefing when a session starts, over a private connection on this computer (a socket, or a named pipe on Windows).

hooks.command: sh -c '{ set +eux; } 2>/dev/null; f=$1; shift; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" "$@" 2>/dev/null; exit 0' sh "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/flashteams-hook.sh" codex SessionStart
hooks.commandWindows: $d = $env:FLASH_CONSOLE_BIN; if (-not $d) { $d = $env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Flash Console\bin' }; $f = $d + '\flashteams.exe'; if ($f -match '^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]' -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { try { & $f --hook codex SessionStart 2>$null } catch { } }; exit 0
